dialogues.original: Trick or treat! Do you like my pumpkin mask?

choices.answer: It's adorable! Did you make it yourself?
Why are you wearing a mask?

dialogues.original: Yes! Well, my mom helped a little bit. It took forever!

choices.answer: I can tell you worked hard on it!
The hard work paid off! Want some candy?

dialogues.original: Thanks! I wanted to be the cutest pumpkin on the block!

choices.answer: You definitely are! How many houses have you visited?

dialogues.original: Because it's Halloween! Everyone wears masks on Halloween!

choices.answer: Fair point! Here's some candy for you.

dialogues.original: It was really fun! Can I have candy now please?

choices.answer: Such good manners! Here you go!

dialogues.original: This is my 10th house! My bag is getting heavy!

choices.answer: Wow! Let me add to that collection!
Only 10? You've got energy for more!
Good taste! Here's some chocolate for you!
